name: optional_per_template
note: product.template.optional_product_ids many2many owner (addons/sale/models/product_template.py:55): optional products per template with the lowest optional template id, as the configurator reads them
source_sql: SELECT src_id, count(*) AS optional_products, min(dest_id) AS first_optional FROM product_optional_rel GROUP BY src_id ORDER BY src_id

name: templates_per_optional
note: the inverse side: templates offering each optional product with the lowest owner id
source_sql: SELECT dest_id, count(*) AS templates, min(src_id) AS first_template FROM product_optional_rel GROUP BY dest_id ORDER BY dest_id
